dct_description_sm: The urbanized Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model is applied to assess the dependence of heat mitigation cooling efficacy in Toronto, Canada during daytime versus nighttime as a function weather type and local built structure and cover. This dataset includes the input and parameter files needed to run all Weather Research & Forecasting (WRF) simulations for the Hesse et al. (2025) publication.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: Different urban heat mitigation strategies are optimal day versus night and for distinct synoptic weather types
